content:
**Grilled Radstag** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A piece of Radstag Meat which has been grilled, making it safer to eat and improving its nutritional value. Eating it enables one to carry more weight.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Radstag Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Radstag Meat | | Grilled Radstag (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after having picked up Radstag Meat for the first time.
- May be sold by Mr. Waiter at the dining room inside the Whitespring Resort.
- Possible reward for completing the daily quest Daily: Thrill of the Grill.
